**Product Update: Introducing Scheduled Reports**

We are pleased to announce the release of Scheduled Reports, a new feature designed to help you stay informed without extra effort.

Scheduled Reports allows you to automate the delivery of your most important dashboards and summaries. Choose the reports you need, set how often they should be generated, and they will be delivered directly to your account inbox on a recurring basis. Daily, weekly, and monthly intervals are supported, and you can adjust or pause any schedule at any time.

Key benefits include:

- **Time savings:** Receive routine reports automatically instead of building them manually.
- **Consistency:** Ensure stakeholders see the same up-to-date information on a regular cadence.
- **Flexibility:** Configure each report independently to match your workflow.

This feature is available now to all customers at no additional cost. You can find it in the Reports section of your dashboard under the new Schedules tab. Existing reports remain unchanged, and no action is required to keep your current setup.

For guidance on creating your first schedule, visit our Help Center, where step-by-step instructions and answers to common questions are available. We welcome your feedback through the in-app feedback form as we continue to improve this feature.
